title: macOS virtualized AMI changelog
content_html:
This AMI listing has multiple actively updated versions:

  • macOS Tahoe with Xcode 26.4 - 26.6
  • macOS Sequoia with Xcode 26.0-26.2
  • macOS Sequoia with Xcode 16.3-16.4
  • macOS Sonoma with Xcode 16.0-16.2
Learn more [how to get notified of updates](https://stacks.bitrise.io/tips/get-notified/).

Updates #
